src/modules/counterfactual-safes/routes/counterfactual-safes.service.ts:90
One nice optimization that is sadly not possible (unless we even change `isSafe`) is if `isSafe` would accept an `signal: AbortSignal` then as soon as we would have found one Promise returning that a Safe is deployed, we could have aborted all other, already launched Promises launched in the map iteration. 

In fact, what would be nice is if there was a `Promise.some` we could just use here. But from what I know TS/JS doesn't have this :/
